name: Melanie Mattison
reason: Too thin: beyond her Kripalu retreat (Personal Energy Clearing, 4-7 Feb 2027), her site (Five Elements Flowing, LLC) offers only in-person personal and space clearings booked by email with no price or page of their own, and a private MeWe community group; her events page says 'check back soon', the shop has no products, the blog has two posts (2021 and a 2023 link to an interview), and there are no books, no free resources and no teaching videos (her only YouTube upload is a personal 2017 clip). The Shift Network and Omega logos on her homepage are 'as seen in' badges with no current programme; checked 1 Nov 2026.
